r9.fill.r9_sw_shelf_skier:
Tove. I came out of the ice tunnel
and found this shelf.

Nobody else knows it's here.
Now you do. Battle?
r9.fill.r9_sw_shelf_skier_after:
Jump off the edge to get down.
You can't get back up that way.
r9.fill.r9_switchbacks_cairn:
A little cairn of flat stones
on the shelf.

The top stone has a fish
scratched on it.
r9.fill.r9_rb_spotter:
Ash. Shh. There's a kite nesting
on the old bank.
r9.fill.r9_rb_spotter_after:
Off you go. Mind the drop back
down to the bed.
r9.fill.r9_riverbed_gully:
A flood mark cut into the rock,
higher than the bank.

Under it, in tiny letters:
"we told them."
